# Copilot instructions for MoriaEngine

The instructions for every developer and coding agent in this repository are in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root: repository shape, build and test commands, how changes
land, and the rules that hold everywhere. Topic rules are in [`.claude/rules/`](../.claude/rules/)
(plain markdown, for any tool): read the one for the area you change, such as
`engine-patterns.md` for C#, `testing.md` for tests, `converter.md` for `scripts/converted/`, and
`lscript.md` for `.def`/`.scp`.

Keep this file a pointer. Add shared rules to `AGENTS.md` or `.claude/rules/`, so that people, Copilot
and Claude Code all read the same thing.
